purpose: Define Port Editor as an Expose projection/editor for named network/service listener configuration and lifecycle across web HTTP, REST, OSC, WebSocket and other installed port-bound protocols.

topics.name: Port Editor
topics.purpose: Define Port Editor as an Expose projection/editor for named network/service listener configuration and lifecycle across web HTTP, REST, OSC, WebSocket and other installed port-bound protocols.

semantics.service_identity_rule: Port Editor edits bindings attached to stable named service identities; it does not use port as identity.
semantics.authority_rule: Port Editor receives no independent listener/runtime authority.
semantics.state_rule: Declared configuration and runtime running state remain distinct.
semantics.default_web_rule: nanoCMS public instance default port 80 remains its canonical default binding.

invariants.rule: Editor subtools are projections/operation surfaces over canonical semantics and do not become independent authorities.

hard_gates.condition: Port Editor treats port as service identity
Port Editor directly mutates listener runtime outside canonical operation
Editor grants itself authority by controlling listener UI
declared binding conflated with running state
protocol service semantics redefined inside Port Editor

references.purpose: Port Editor edits canonical listener bindings.
Bindings attach to named service instances.
